description: This file contains utility functions, global variable declarations, and module imports for the Notesnook editor mobile project, including message posting, theme management, and React Native WebView interactions.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root element or window for message subscription, specific to React Native WebView and Safari.

methods.name: getOnMessageListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener for 'onMessage' events and provides a method to remove it.

methods.name: randId
methods.description: Generates a random ID string with a specified prefix.

methods.name: isReactNative
methods.description: Checks if the environment is React Native WebView.

methods.name: logger
methods.description: Logs messages of type 'info', 'warn', or 'error' via post message.

methods.name: dbLogger
methods.description: Logs database-related messages of type 'log' or 'error' via post message.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a message to React Native WebView with specified type and data, returns a generated resolver ID.

methods.name: postAsyncWithTimeout
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous post message with optional timeout, resolving with the response or rejecting on timeout.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Saves a theme object to local storage.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the theme object from local storage.
